label: Declassified

szenen.text: A gift hung in the U.S. ambassador's office. It was *spying.*
In 1945, Soviet schoolchildren gave it to ambassador Averell Harriman.

archiv.datei: File:116 Averell Harriman greets Soviet officer - USACE-p15141coll5-9476.jpeg

szenen.text: It was a carved wooden *Great Seal* of the United States.

archiv.datei: File:Great Seal bug - National Cryptologic Museum - DSC08048.JPG

szenen.text: Inside was a tiny device with *no battery.*

archiv.datei: File:Great Seal bug - National Cryptologic Museum - DSC08049.JPG

szenen.text: It only worked when Soviet radio beams *hit it.*
Today it's known as *The Thing.* Its design shocked engineers.
What gifts are *listening* today? Follow for more.
